title: Power Apps: consolidated AI settings for model-driven apps in Maker Studio and Copilot hub
summary: Hold: the per-user licensing classification omits the consumption-based licensing that the briefing itself documents for row summaries. The roadmap facts and the app-designer control check out, but the licensing field needs to distinguish user licences from AI Builder and Copilot Credits.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to consolidate model-driven app AI settings across Maker Studio and the Power Platform admin center.
claims.quote: Consolidated AI settings make it easier for makers and admins to find and manage AI capabilities for model-driven apps across two complementary surfaces.

claims.claim: The planned Maker Studio location is a new top-level Copilot and AI tab in the Settings dialog in the model app form designer.
claims.quote: In Maker Studio, the Settings dialog in the model app form designer adds a new top-level Copilot and AI tab.

claims.claim: The planned maker tab gathers the app's available AI options in one place.
claims.quote: Makers can see and adjust all available AI options for the app in one place instead of finding them scattered among all the other settings.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes the admin-side move as Environment > Settings to Copilot Hub > Power Apps.
claims.quote: In the Power Platform admin center, model-driven app AI settings are consolidated from Environment > Settings into Copilot Hub > Power Apps.

claims.claim: The roadmap names Generative pages among the consolidated settings.
claims.quote: This provides a central location for settings such as Generative pages, Copilot in apps, and the in-app AI skills.

claims.claim: The roadmap names Copilot in apps among the consolidated settings.
claims.quote: This provides a central location for settings such as Generative pages, Copilot in apps, and the in-app AI skills.

claims.claim: The old model-driven app AI switches under Environment > Settings are planned for retirement and removal.
claims.quote: As part of this consolidation, the old model-driven app AI switches under Environment > Settings will also be retired and removed.
